designSystem.colorMode: DARK (default; light variant + user switch planned)
revisions: 2026-10-11: 12-color threshold palette + palette-or-custom-picker rule per updated spec

screens.title: Meander — Application Shell
screens.notes: Left-rail shell: wordmark, Board/Backlog/Settings nav, profile footer slot, quiet empty state

screens.title: Meander — Settings
screens.notes: Settings page: Profiles section (list rows, Current badge) + Database section. Generated extras omitted from implementation: Storage & Privacy section, row action buttons

screens.title: Meander — Settings (Inline Profile Edit)
screens.notes: Profile row inline edit: name becomes input with Save/Cancel; other rows gain a Rename button. Generated extras omitted: Switch buttons, duplicated input, Storage & Privacy section, Offline badge

screens.title: Meander — Backlog
screens.notes: Task list rows (title, estimate, status badge, hover-revealed delete icon button at row end) + empty state. Generated extras omitted: stats strip, checkboxes, Add Task button (step 16), Offline badge (removed earlier)

screens.title: Meander — New Task Modal
screens.notes: Task creation dialog: Title* input, Description textarea, Categories token-field multiselect (selected pill chips tinted per category color inline inside the field box, input caret right of the last chip, open dropdown with color dots + check marks + 'New category...' create row), Estimated time, Carry-over segmented control, collapsible Repeat section (disclosure row with summary chip + expanded controls: 'Every' interval input + days/weeks/months segmented unit, weekday toggle chips for weeks, two radio rows 'On day [n]' / 'On the [1st-Last] [weekday]' for months, Starts/Ends date inputs; no select elements), Cancel/Create task footer over dimmed backlog. Repeat markup and dialog scroll constraint spliced locally from Stitch DOM edit events — the remote htmlCode/screenshot artifacts lag behind DOM operations.

screens.title: Meander — Task Detail Modal
screens.notes: Task edit dialog over dimmed backlog: pre-filled title/description, Estimated time + Time spent paired h/min inputs, Status and Carry-over segmented controls, read-only Created/Updated footer metadata, Cancel/Save actions

screens.title: Meander — Categories
screens.notes: Categories list: color dot + title rows with 'Created <date>' metadata, Categories nav item between Backlog and Settings, Add Category button, empty state. Generated extras omitted: stats cards, 'N tasks' counts (step 24), footer tip

screens.title: Meander — New Category Modal
screens.notes: Category creation dialog: Title* input, optional Description textarea, Color as a radiogroup of palette swatches with a default option and a custom color picker, Cancel/Create category footer over dimmed categories page

screens.title: Meander — Edit Category Modal
screens.notes: Edit variant of the new-category dialog: pre-filled Title/Description, a non-default swatch selected in the color radiogroup, "Save changes" primary action over the dimmed categories page.

screens.title: Meander — Task Details Modal (Read-Only)
screens.notes: Read-only task details view over dimmed backlog: task heading + Edit secondary button + close, description/status/estimate/spent/carry-over/category chips as plain text, Created/Updated metadata, series section ('Repeats weekly on Monday — series created …') with compact month calendar (teal dots on scheduled Mondays, selected day highlighted), 'Current instance'/'Series' notes tabs with 'No notes yet.' empty state, 'Apply changes to' radio group (This instance only selected; Entire series / This and future instances disabled with 'available when series editing lands' hint), Close footer
